info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Credit Check API provides a seamless way to access the credit check status of submitted credit card applications. This endpoint allows financial institutions and service providers to retrieve essential credit check information associated with customer applications. Typical consumers include loan officers and application processors who require quick access to credit assessment data to expedite decision-making. Enhanced integration with this API can streamline the credit approval process and improve customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve Credit Check Status for an Application
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the credit check status associated with a specific application. It provides essential insights into the credit assessment process to aid in decision-making.
